name: Obtain the Local Content Certificate from the competent authority
Agree the Parent Company Guarantee wording (substantially Form 4-D; unconditional for the construction period) with the EPC Contractor's ultimate parent
Obtain the board resolutions of each member authorising its signatories

Write the Technical Proposal narrative (process design to Table 2-2 (revised) with 12 °C for nitrification, ADD-03 6.2; the effective TN limit; standby power 72 hours, ADD-03 5.2; noise 40 dB(A) by night; page limit as amended)
Complete the Financial Model (unlocked, fully formula-linked Excel, no macros, no hard-coded values in calculation cells)
Obtain the client completion certificate for each reference project (a reference without one is disregarded, VOL-I 9.5)
Notarise the Power of Attorney of each signatory (Form 4-A signatory of the lead member; Form 4-C signatory of each member)
Collect commercial-operation evidence for the reference plants (capacity, commercial operation within the look-back window)
Obtain bank approval for the Bid Bond
Review the data-room geotechnical report and satisfy the Bidder as to ground conditions (e.g. the wadi crossing; ADD-01 Q4); feed the construction methodology and the price
Obtain indicative financing terms (debt tenor, margin, gearing) for the model
Review Volume V and list every deviation, qualification or reservation
Obtain evidence of the O&M Operator's continuous operation of a qualifying facility (VOL-I 8.8)
Obtain the executed Parent Company Guarantee from the ultimate parent

Legalise (embassy or consulate of the Kingdom in the country of execution) or apostille each Power of Attorney executed outside the Kingdom, in addition to notarisation (ADD-03 Q16; otherwise treated as not submitted)

Process simulation report (at most 25 pages; an appendix outside the VOL-I 9.2 page limit): Table 2-4 as amended at the Table 2-2 (revised) peak values and 12 °C (ADD-03 Table 2-2 note 3; without it, no marks under criterion A)
Submit clarification requests citing Volume, Clause and page (e.g. Form 4-A printed date; Envelope B contents; one USB per envelope)
Collect each member's most recent audited financial statements (three financial years)
Review the six Form 4-G undertakings with the O&M and OT security leads
Prepare Form 4-C in Arabic for each member
For each foreign member: evidence of a current investment licence, or a signed undertaking to obtain it before Financial Close (VOL-I 8.9)
Prepare one Form 4-B for each reference project from the reference evidence, every printed field drafted (preparation; not gated)
Issue the Bid Bond (validity per VOL-I 6.3)
Freeze the Financial Model (final inputs and version) for Form 4-F
Compute and evidence combined tangible net worth and three-year average turnover, weighted by shareholding (VOL-I 8.4)
Sign and stamp Form 4-C at each member (Arabic governs; a translation may be attached)

Register through the Portal the names and identity document numbers of up to two representatives who will deliver the Proposal (VOL-I 6.8 as inserted by ADD-03 2.4; access is refused to anyone not registered)
Prepare the schedule of principal financing assumptions to accompany Form 4-F (VOL-I 10.6)
Prepare Form 4-A on the version reissued by ADD-01 Appendix A: Bidder and lead member, Addenda acknowledged, single point of contact (preparation; not gated)
Finalise and sign Form 4-E; check that no qualification appears elsewhere in the Proposal (VOL-I 9.6)
Complete and sign Form 4-F from the frozen Financial Model (single Availability Payment, SAR per annum, excluding VAT)
Obtain a copy of the EPC Contractor's ISO 9001:2015 certificate and check it is current at the PDD
Confirm the single point of contact to be named in Form 4-A; notify any later change within 2 Working Days (VOL-I 4.3)
Finalise Form 4-A (which form version and fields, and how its stale printed Proposal Due Date is corrected, as decided on I-F4A-FIELDS) and sign by the lead member's PoA holder

Finalise each Form 4-B: the 'Contract value (SAR equivalent)' field is kept (not deleted or relocated) and completed as the decision on I-VOL-I-ENV-A-PRICES directs (VOL-I 6.2: no commercial information in Envelope A)
Complete and sign Form 4-G

Assemble the marked original of Envelope A in the VOL-I 9.1 order as re-lettered by ADD-03 7.1 ((a) to (j); Form 4-G is (f)), with numbered dividers following the re-lettered list; check that no price or commercial information appears (VOL-I 6.2)

Assemble the marked original of Envelope B: Form 4-F and the Financial Model on a second, separate encrypted USB (VOL-I 10.1; ADD-03 Q20); no model auditor's opinion (ADD-03 4.1); package the financing-assumptions schedule as the decision on I-VOL-I-ENV-B directs (it is prepared regardless)

Make three hard copies of each envelope and the searchable electronic copy of Envelope A only on encrypted USB (ADD-03 Q20), files named ISTP2026-014_[BIDDER]_[ENV]_[VOL]_[NN]_[YYYYMMDD].pdf (max 120 characters, folders max 3 levels); check the electronic copy against the marked original (VOL-I 6.5, Appendix 2); the USB split between the envelopes follows the decision on I-VOL-I-COPIES
Seal Envelopes A and B separately and mark each 'NUPA/ISTP/2026/014 — NOT TO BE OPENED BEFORE 11:00 ON THE PROPOSAL DUE DATE' (VOL-I 6.2, Appendix 3 as replaced by ADD-03 2.3)

Deliver both sealed envelopes to Tender Box 2, First Floor, Administrative Building A, Sakaka before 11:00 Riyadh time on the PDD by a representative registered under VOL-I 6.8 (VOL-I 6.1 and Appendix 3 as amended by ADD-03 2.1 and 2.3; late Proposals are rejected unopened, VOL-I 6.6); then submit the password of each USB through the Portal within one hour (ADD-03 Q20)

Audit of the Financial Model and issue of the opinion addressed to the Authority within 45 days after the Preferred Bidder Notification (VOL-I 12.5 as inserted by ADD-03 4.2; no longer with the Proposal, ADD-03 4.1)
Rolling review of the draft Financial Model by the model auditor
Appoint the independent model auditor (opinion to be addressed to the Authority)
